verdict.rationale: Designs can be exported to open formats (HTML, PDF, PPTX), and a Claude team member states the designs are plain HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle. A user also reports that a data export includes the code. Portability has real caveats, though: users lost in-app access to their projects after unsubscribing, SVG export strips animations unless you work around it, and the generated code is described as hard to maintain. Missing for 10: a documented native project/file format spec, first-party docs confirming the underlying format is HTML/CSS/JS, reliable access to designs after unsubscribing, and lossless SVG export.
